definitions.acc_T: argmax goal accuracy at t = 30 on a test episode: 8,000 episodes of the network's held-out test states (forward only), the native test (= test_acc_through_training[:, -1] of the .pth files, acc_T of log.jsonl)
definitions.updates: Adam updates (batch 8000) done before the test
definitions.trap (in-process): from the test pass itself, see run_variant_er.py docstring: fixed logits F_t = episode mean of the cumulative logits; excluded = F_30 > 10 nats below the best cell of its row AND column; alive = 100 - excluded; gap1 = F_1's gap below its row's best (min of row/column gap also); frozen rows (v) = median over the row of sqrt(v_hat) < Adam eps (1e-8); fp16-zero rows = every entry of the row's gradient exactly 0 at the last update; M1_l1 = ||episode mean of u_1||_1; u1_share = ||M_1||^2 / mean ||u_1||^2
definitions.offline: measure_ckpt.py: the same metrics on 2,000 held-out pool episodes (fresh environments), CPU fp32
definitions.convergence: change of acc_T and of the held-out own loss (orig_loss) between the first and last test in the last 20% of updates; label 'converged' only if the accuracy moved < 0.01 AND the loss fell by < 1% there, else 'still rising (lower bound)'

R3_joint_trainedstart.note: checkpoint_every 500, 50000 episodes; test i after (episode - earlier tests) updates

R1_marginal_trainedstart.note: checkpoint_every 500, 50000 episodes; test i after (episode - earlier tests) updates

R1e5_marginal_trainedstart.note: checkpoint_every 5, 50000 episodes; test i after (episode - earlier tests) updates

A_vs_R4_paired_same_test_episodes.definition: A and R4 share the seed, the initial read-in/read-out, the numpy data stream and the test schedule, so every test batch is the same 8,000 episodes (checked: identical Bayes and naive accuracies on every batch); differences are paired

start_noise.definition: start_noise.py on the 2,000 pool episodes: share_noise(t) = var over two independent per-episode start draws of the cumulative logits (half the mean squared difference) / across-episode variance of the logits with one draw; acc_T with draw a, draw b and start 0; answer_flip_share = share of episodes whose t=30 goal answer differs between the two draws

validation.start_state_checks: runs/A_joint_er/start_checks.json, runs/B_marg_er/start_checks.json: (h0,c0) received by the LSTM = (1, 2000, 1000) slice of the batch's draw, mean 0.000, std 1.000, across-episode std per unit 1.000, 100/100 distinct rows, a new draw every episode (training and test), requires_grad False

timing.note: B waited 62 min for a slot and A lost its slot for 61 min at its chunk boundary (all 5 shared slots were held by other agents' self-relaunching drivers); from 12:07 two workers shared slots round robin
timing.memory: peak 2.17 GiB allocated, 2.80 GiB reserved, 3.1 GiB on nvidia-smi (micro 2000, expandable segments); one 8000 pass: 8.1 GiB allocated, ~10 GB on the card
timing.converged_comparison_estimate: R4 needed 50,000 updates (0.62 on test states, still rising), R3 and R1 plateau after ~25,000; at the measured 1.29-1.41 s/update (micro 2000, shared GPU): 25k updates = 9-10 h, 50k = 18-20 h per run; micro 4000 (0.94 s/update measured in the smoke test, 5.9 GB on the card): 50k = 13 h; the separation window where R3 flattens and R4 pulls away (10-15k updates) = 3.6-5.9 h per run
